orderCancelled.title: [TET] Order Cancelled
orderCancelled.content: [TET] Your order {orderNo} has been cancelled. Reason: {reason}

orderDelivered.title: [TET] Order Delivered
orderDelivered.content: [TET] Your order {orderNo} has been delivered. Enjoy!

taskFailed.title: [TET] Task Cancelled

retentionWinback.title: [TET] We miss you!
retentionWinback.content: [TET] It has been a while since your last order. Here is a coupon for your next visit!

firstPurchaseNudge.title: [TET] Place your first order
firstPurchaseNudge.content: [TET] Welcome! New customers get a special coupon on their first order.

repurchaseThanks.title: [TET] Thank you for your loyalty
repurchaseThanks.content: [TET] Thanks for your {orderNo} — another order completed. We would love your review!

birthdayGreeting.title: [TET] Happy Birthday!
birthdayGreeting.content: [TET] Wishing you a wonderful birthday. A gift coupon is waiting for you!

replenishReminder.title: [TET] Time to restock
replenishReminder.content: [TET] Your subscribed product may be running low. Reorder in one tap.

cartRecall.title: [TET] Your cart is waiting
cartRecall.content: [TET] You left items in your cart. Come back and complete your order!

autoReplenishDue.title: [TET] Time to reorder
autoReplenishDue.content: [TET] The product you regularly buy is likely due. Reorder in one tap.

priceDropAlert.title: [TET] Price dropped!
priceDropAlert.content: [TET] A product on your price watch list has dropped. Check it out!

restockAlert.title: [TET] Back in stock
restockAlert.content: [TET] A product on your restock watch list is available again.

viewNudge.title: [TET] Still thinking it over?
viewNudge.content: [TET] You viewed this product a few days ago. It might be just what you need.

outOfStock.title: [TET] Item Out of Stock
outOfStock.content: [TET] Some items in your order {orderNo} are out of stock: {items}. Tap to view details.

outOfStockCancelled.title: [TET] Order Cancelled - Items Out of Stock
outOfStockCancelled.content: [TET] All items in your order {orderNo} are out of stock ({items}). The order has been cancelled and will be refunded automatically.

outOfStockAutoRefunded.title: [TET] Refund Completed
outOfStockAutoRefunded.content: [TET] Your order {orderNo} items were out of stock. A refund of ${amount} has been automatically issued. If you disagree, you can dispute it in the order details.

outOfStockRefundPending.title: [TET] Refund Being Processed
outOfStockRefundPending.content: [TET] Some items in your order {orderNo} were out of stock. Your refund of ${amount} is being processed and will arrive after review.

outOfStockSuggestion.title: [TET] Replacement Suggestion
outOfStockSuggestion.content: [TET] An item in your order {orderNo} is out of stock. A replacement is suggested: {items}. Tap to confirm or decline.

outOfStockSuggestionExpired.title: [TET] Replacement Expired
outOfStockSuggestionExpired.content: [TET] You did not respond to the replacement suggestion for order {orderNo} in time. The out-of-stock item will be refunded automatically.

ticketCreated.title: [TET] Issue Ticket Created
ticketCreated.content: [TET] An issue ticket {ticketNo} has been created for your order {orderNo}. Our support team will follow up.
